Method of Attack: HTTPS interception detection by ingesting User Agents and TLS Client Hello fingerprints to identify intercepted TLS connections
Detects HTTPS interception and robust TLS fingerprinting to identify software used by attackers
Attack Vector: Interception of TLS connections via proxies or middleboxes
Devices with installed root certificates allowing third-party decryption
Origin servers providing TLS private keys to third parties (reverse proxies)
